summary: Evotec SE (—) filed a Form 6-K attaching a notification of major holdings under German law, disclosing that The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. crossed a 3% threshold on June 23, 2026, now holding an aggregate 14.62% voting rights (0.16% shares + 14.46% through instruments). The filing reflects a non-routine accumulation of economic exposure via swaps, recallable borrowings, and convertible bonds – a hallmark of post-takeover-position accumulation – without a formal tender or acquisition. Since the activation of such a large stake is typically prelude to engagement, it falls under Activist Campaigns. Watch for potential board changes or strategic demands.
